convert_pt_to_pil: convert a PyTorch tensor image to a PIL image with normalized pixel values
convert_numpy_to_pil: convert a numpy array image or batch of images to a list of PIL images
build_image_grid: build a grid of PIL images with specified rows and columns for visualization
test_pt_to_pil: test the pt_to_pil function with a PyTorch tensor input
test_make_image_grid: test the make_image_grid function with a list of PIL images and grid dimensions
